meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 仍负责整体调度，但能通过新增的 MCP 工具把任务交给本地运行的 Atomic Chat 模型：可列出可用模型，或向指定模型发送提示并取回回复。
howto.when: 当用户要求使用 Atomic Chat 处理任务（如让某个模型回答问题）时，agent 会先列出可用模型，再调用生成工具。

say.text: 用 Atomic Chat 告诉我法国的首都
say.note: 会先列出模型，再选一个生成回答

say.text: 列出当前 Atomic Chat 里有哪些模型

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude stays the orchestrator but can offload work to local models via Atomic Chat MCP tools: one lists available models, another sends a prompt to a specified model and returns the response.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to use Atomic Chat for a task; the agent lists models first, then generates a response.

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Lists models, then picks one to answer

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: 1+1=?
say_en.note: Explicit tool and model get a reply

say_en.text: List the models currently available in Atomic Chat
